title: APIv2 PCR Prep 1/4: HYB
author: Opentrons
materials: for 96 samples using the P20 Multi-channel pipette. --- * [P20 Multi-channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [10/20uL Opentrons tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601](bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Labcon 0.2mL PCR strips #3940-550](http://www.labcon.com/microstrips.html) * Labcon Plate --- Slot
96-well Bio-Rad PCR plate filled with DNA samples. Slots 4-11: [10/20ul Opentrons tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect a P20 Multi‑channel pipette, 10/20 µL Opentrons tip‑racks, Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL, catalog #hsp9601), Labcon 0.2 mL PCR strips (catalog #3940‑550) and a Labcon plate, sufficient for 96 samples.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place a clean empty 96‑well Labcon plate on the PCR cooler in Slot 1; put a pre‑chilled PCR Thermal Block with a PCR strip (filled with master mix) in Slot 2, column 1; load the 96‑well Bio‑Rad PCR plate containing DNA samples in Slot 3; load 10/20 µL Opentrons tip‑racks in Slots 4‑11.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters (e.g., volumes, temperatures, timings) into the Opentrons software as prompted.

steps.title: Obtain protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Load protocol into OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, confirm that the deck is set up according to the deck map matching the physical arrangement described above.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate the labware, tip‑rack, and the P20 Multi‑channel pipette following the on‑screen instructions or support articles.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press "Run" in the Opentrons App to start the PCR preparation (HYB) protocol for the 96 samples.
